attchmntText: Supreme Engineering Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Supreme Engineering Limited reported audited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, following a Board meeting on November 14, 2026. The company recorded a profit of 177.89 INR Lakhs for the half year. A significant subsequent event is the completion of a One-Time Settlement with its lender on November 11, 2026, resulting in a No Due Certificate. The settlement gain will be recognized in the quarter ending December 31, 2026. The company's secured loan was previously classified as a Non-Performing Asset in August 2021. Revenue for the half year was 985.69 INR Lakhs. Earnings per Share for the half year was 0.74 INR. The financial statements were reviewed by M/s Rushabh Davda and Associates.

attchmntText: Supreme Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the payment of the One-Time Settlement (OTS) amount to Bank of India.
voiceSummary: Supreme Engineering Limited has paid the One-Time Settlement amount to Bank of India. The payment was made in accordance with the terms of the OTS approval granted by the bank. The company paid Rs. 60.32 crore plus applicable interest. This payment represents the full and final settlement of all outstanding dues. Bank of India has issued a settlement certificate. The bank has released all attached properties and guarantees. The reason for opting for the OTS was to reduce the debt liability of the company. This intimation is submitted under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The managing director is Sanjay Chowdhri.

attchmntText: Supreme Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 145000000 securities pursuant to Convertible Securities at its meeting held on November 10, 2026
voiceSummary: Supreme Engineering Limited has allotted 14,50,00,000 fully convertible warrants on November 10, 2026, at Rs. 2.60 per warrant, aggregating to Rs. 37,70,00,000. The allotment was made to seven investors, including Sanjay Chowdhri, Abhinav Chowdhri, Pranav Chowdhri, Hardik D. Parekh, Trina Vyas, Tanaisha Vyas, and Nikita Hardik Parekh. Each warrant is convertible into one equity share within 18 months. An upfront payment of 25% or 25.64% of the issue price has been received. The warrants were issued pursuant to board resolutions from September 1, 2026, and September 24, 2026, a special resolution passed at the Annual General Meeting on October 1, 2026, and in-principle approval from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited dated October 26, 2026.

attchmntText: Supreme Engineering Limited Receipt of In-Principle Approval from the Stock Exchanges for Preferential Issue.
